reference_findings.diagnosis: SCAD is a differential diagnosis in this synthetic ACS presentation; angiographic appearance must be interpreted by experienced clinicians and distinguished from atherosclerosis/spasm.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: Potential ACS / diagnosis-sensitive; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: T-wave inversion and subtle ST changes in anterior leads; no definitive pattern at first reading.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Serial hs-cTn rises above fictional assay threshold; CBC, renal function and electrolytes without major simulated abnormality.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: long smooth tapering narrowing in mid-to-distal LAD with preserved distal flow; no obvious focal calcified plaque. Image quality is intentionally limited and diagnosis remains uncertain without expert review.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 92 bpm; BP 118/74 mmHg; RR 18/min; SpO2 98%; stable at initial snapshot.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Acute chest pain after intense emotional stress; discomfort persists for 30 minutes.
history.history_of_present_illness: No known prior coronary disease. Scenario includes a recent major stressor; it is a clue, not proof of SCAD.
relevant_history: Pregnancy/postpartum history must be asked when relevant, not assumed

differential_diagnosis: Takotsubo syndrome or myocarditis depending on further imaging

pathway_review.label: Escalate for expert review of possible SCAD and stability
pathway_review.reason: Correct recognition matters because management differs from routine atherosclerotic PCI.

pathway_review.label: Automatically stent a long smooth lesion without confirming mechanism
pathway_review.reason: Unnecessary intervention can be harmful in SCAD; this is a reasoning trap, not a procedural guide.

pathway_review.label: Consider reviewed diagnostic clarification and myocardial imaging where clinically appropriate
pathway_review.reason: Choice depends on stability, uncertainty and expert guidance.

reference_findings.safety_review: Do not make the simulator imply all SCAD requires PCI. Emphasize clinical stability, expert review, associated-condition assessment and monitored care decisions.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: expert review favours SCAD; no automatic PCI is performed in the stable synthetic branch. If instability is introduced, route to urgent specialist escalation.
learning_objectives: Recognize a non-atherosclerotic cause of ACS.
Avoid equating every angiographic narrowing with plaque.
Discuss why intervention decisions differ by mechanism.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
